```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false


library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(DT)

times_data <- tibble(
  timestamp = c(
    "03/12/24 14:03",
    "03/12/24 14:05",
    "03/12/24 15:10",
    "03/12/24 15:22",
    "03/12/24 16:01"
  ),
  message = c(
    "ERROR: user=482 failed-login",
    "INFO: user=511 login-success",
    "WARN: user=482 retry-login",
    "ERROR: user=222 failed-login",
    "INFO: user=482 login-success"
  )
)
```



# Tab 1 - Data Cleaning

## Row 1

```{r}
#| title: Messy Data
# Show messy data table here

datatable(times_data)
```


## Row 2

```{r}
#| title: Clean Data
# Show clean data table here

times_clean <- times_data |>
  mutate(
    level = str_extract(message, "ERROR|WARN|INFO"),
    user_id = str_extract(message, "(?<=user=)\\d+"),
    event = str_extract(message, "(failed-login|login-success|retry-login)")
  )

times_clean <- times_clean |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = mdy_hm(timestamp),
    hour = hour(timestamp),
    date = as_date(timestamp)
  )

datatable(times_clean)
```

# Tab 2 - Chart

```{r}
# Add a graphic here of Events by Hour

events_by_hour <- times_clean |>
  count(hour)

events_chart <- ggplot(events_by_hour, aes(x = hour, y = n)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Events by Hour",
    x = "Hour of Day",
    y = "Number of Events"
  )

events_chart
```

Analysis: Most activity occurs at 14:00 and 15:00, each with two events recorded. The data suggests login activity is concentrated in the early afternoon, with fewer events later in the day.
